11300bff7c39a6106364f3fe001e26f8.overview: On a rainy day, a mother and daughter forego a trip to the park to bake pastries and partake in a two-person tea party when an unexpected guest menacingly invites himself into the house and ransacks the food and drink in the house.
11300bff7c39a6106364f3fe001e26f8.tagline: Based on the book by Judith Kerr

113c035c44230123cd5c8f78400f5771.overview: A novelist's longstanding marriage is suddenly upended when she overhears her husband giving his honest reaction to her latest book.

114be5f8dc71ff53ccf2f6cbf597077f.overview: After a botched bank robbery lands his younger brother in prison, Connie Nikas embarks on a twisted odyssey through New York City's underworld to get his brother Nick out of jail.
114be5f8dc71ff53ccf2f6cbf597077f.tagline: Are you ready for a Good Time?

117c49154ea564727a3329916adfa8bb.overview: A renegade police captain sets out to catch a sadistic mob boss.  Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in 2016.

11972d5ef4cf83e07ea48a6ab2030e20.overview: Benji is a stray who has nonetheless worked his way into the hearts of a number of the townspeople, who give him food and attention whenever he stops by. His particular favorites are a pair of children who feed and play with him against the wishes of their parents. When the children are kidnapped, however, the parents and the police are at a loss to find them. Only Benji can track them down, but will he be in time? If he can save the day, he may just find the permanent home he's been longing for.

11acf5eafec6a02dfb41bdc0678ff113.overview: Joe Gideon is at the top of the heap, one of the most successful directors and choreographers in musical theater. But he can feel his world slowly collapsing around him - his obsession with work has almost destroyed his personal life, and only his bottles of pills keep him going.
11acf5eafec6a02dfb41bdc0678ff113.tagline: All that work. All that glitter. All that pain. All that love. All that crazy rhythm.

11b2d524bd880c58a621f9157de667f9.overview: A bounty hunter trying to bring a murderer to justice is forced to accept the help of two less-than-trustworthy strangers.

11ba375f4b8a78076fa1ed5fa3cb0141.overview: Part documentary, part concert film, part fever dream, this film captures the troubled spirit of America in 1975 and the joyous music that Dylan performed during the fall of that year.

11bb8d42eec7feb77bd7e914af733125.overview: Judy O'Brien is an aspiring ballerina in a dance troupe. Also in the company is Bubbles, a brash mantrap who leaves the struggling troupe for a career in burlesque. When the company disbands, Bubbles gives Judy a thankless job as her stooge. The two eventually clash when both fall for the same man.
11bb8d42eec7feb77bd7e914af733125.tagline: Heartbreak Behind Gayety of a Girly-Girl Show!

11edf5637c32e472471dfd9f1bc81ebf.overview: Story of people whose lives were changed because of a year-long delay in the delivery of some letters.

11f3bf061afd91eb9482ae961a373ae2.overview: Dorrigo Evans, an Australian surgeon on the Burma Railway during WWII, is haunted by his time as a POW, as well as a forbidden affair he had with his uncle's wife prior to the war.
